column1: Coat the chicken in Maple Chicken Marinade and refrigerate at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Cook the chicken until it reaches 165°F (74°C), rest a few minutes, then slice.
Slice the strawberries, cucumber and avocados.
Toss the spinach with the strawberries, cucumber and avocado.
Top with the pine nuts, crumbled feta and sliced chicken.
